name: Katie Petrillo
bioAdditions: The 1910 census lists 'Katie', a daughter aged 13, born in Pennsylvania (S1). Marie is recorded as mother of 6 children, all 6 living, and exactly six children are listed: Katie, Peter, Frank, Joseph, Tony and Charlie. Grace Petrillo, born 5 Jan 1897, would have been 13 in April 1910, yet she does not appear unless she is 'Katie'. Grace's 1943 repatriation card confirms she was US-born on that date (S2). Katie and Grace are therefore very probably the same girl ('Katie' perhaps a mishearing of 'Gracie'). In the 1920 census the 23-year-old at no. 1028 is recorded as 'Chas', son, male, a coal-mine laborer (S3). That entry is unexplained, since Charles Thomas was only 13. It may be a garbled entry for the same child, or a separate son not otherwise recorded.

conflicts.siteValue: Katie (c.1897 – before 1935) as a separate child from Grace (b. 5 Jan 1897)
conflicts.foundValue: Only six children existed in 1910 and Grace is not otherwise listed
conflicts.assessment: Probable duplicate: merge Katie into Grace (H0351). The 'before 1935' death has no source.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: As a separate person Katie is probably a duplicate of Grace; keep only as an alias pending John's review.

openQuestionsResolved.question: Files list Katie (c.1897) and Grace (b. 5 Jan 1897) separately; whether they overlap was not examined
openQuestionsResolved.answer: Examined: the 1910 census has 6 children born / 6 living and lists Katie (F, 13) with no Grace. Grace (b. Jan 1897, US-born) must be Katie. Probable.
